anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curvature with a moderate pixel radius forming the anterior-dorsal cranial bulge.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1.2:1 visible at the top-right apex.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark circular lesion or mark on the mid-lateral surface; irregular pale depigmentation patch on the lower right marginal boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Saturated monochromatic cyan/teal visual appearance across the entire subject body.
